localChanges: A Bomber can stay out for one turn, but it is lost if it isn't back in one of your cities or on a Carrier by the end of its second turn, whether or not it used all its moves. A Fighter must land by the end of the turn it took off in.
A Bomber's turn ends after it attacks, so it can only drop its bombs once a turn.

log: Fuel was only checked when an aircraft's moves reached exactly 0, so one that ended its turn with moves to spare, or landed in a city with moves left, was never counted. The count was also held in a module-level Map, which a save dropped, and the crash criterion called `transportRegistry.getByUnit`, which throws for a unit that isn't aboard anything.

A `TurnEnd` rule now counts the turns each aircraft ends away from one of its player's cities or a carrier, in a `StrategyNote` so the count is saved. A Bomber is lost at the end of its second turn out, a Fighter or Nuclear at the end of its first.
A Bomber's moves are set to 0 after it attacks, so it can't attack twice in a turn.
